title: Honda & Acura Brake Adapter
lead: A new brake adapter for Honda and Acura vehicles. It replaces the 98407A adapter.
body: Angled locking tabs match the OEM cap, so the adapter locks into place more easily and holds pressure through the entire service, for a quick, reliable brake fluid exchange.
source: TSB Vol. 25 No. 02 - Honda and Acura Brake Adpater.pdf
